answer: Pay each agent by its marginal contribution, not its headcount. After each task, the protocol rescores the result with each agent left out, a Shapley estimate over about 20 sampled coalitions (assumed). A clone adds nothing its twin didn't already supply, so dropping it changes nothing and its share falls toward zero. Fifty copies of one model form an island of echoes; like a pond of identical lotus blooms, one flower carries the value. Agents with distinct skills each hold up their own timber in the frame.
